text: Which genes enhanced in astrocytes (single-cell) are expressed in every brain region and have no detectable mRNA in liver?
plan: Cell type category (scRNA): Astrocytes / Cell type enhanced AND Brain region category (RNA): any / Detected in all AND Tissue category (RNA): Liver / Not detected
understanding: Find human genes that are enhanced in astrocytes according to single-cell RNA-seq, expressed across all brain regions, and have no detectable RNA expression in liver tissue.

trail.why: The requirement specifically asks for genes enhanced in astrocytes at the single-cell level, corresponding to 'Astrocytes' at Level 1 and 'Cell type enhanced' at Level 2.
The category 'Detected in all' identifies genes detected in every region of the brain dataset, leaving Level 1 unrestricted to cover all brain regions.
Selecting 'liver' at Level 1 combined with 'Not detected' at Level 2 precisely identifies genes with mRNA below the detection cut-off in liver tissue.

requirements.why: It defines RNA specificity and distribution categories (such as enhanced) across 81 single-cell types, including Astrocytes.
It classifies RNA distribution and specificity across human brain regions, covering ubiquitous or broad brain expression categories.
It specifies RNA specificity and expression distribution across human tissues, including liver, allowing selection of genes not detected in liver.
